title: Curate, explained
brief: The app explainer (2:50 when complete): the problem, Zee, your wardrobe from your photos, chatting with Zee, the weather, Try-ons and 'Tell me when it's ready'. Warm and simple, for the website, YouTube and onboarding. Built so far: the opening chapter (the problem, Meet Zee, 'Already in your photos'), ported from the round-2 ExOpen motion test. The voiceover is config (config/voice.json): captions only, a human take or a TTS voice, with no code change.
hook: A wall of your own clothes that never settles, and 'Nothing to wear.'
disclosures: Emma is an AI-generated persona: use the platform's AI label (TikTok 'AI-generated content', Meta 'AI info', YouTube 'altered or synthetic content').
If the voice is TTS: say it is an AI voice (OpenAI's usage policies require a clear disclosure that the voice is AI-generated, not a human).
A cut voiced by the 'say-preview' profile (macOS say) is PREVIEW ONLY and never ships.
Music: Mixkit Stock Music Free License; YouTube and the website are fine, never register it with Content ID, no TV/radio.
notes: Words: script.json (all 26 lines of the 2:50 film). Only the opening scenes (problem, meet-zee, photos) are built; the 30-s variant is that opening. Its length follows the narration plan: 27 s on the script's hints in captions mode, longer if the voice needs it.
